profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer
profile.summary:
* Have writen device drivers in C++ (Windows/Linux) for radio frequency tag scanners.
* Eight years of experience in writing device drivers, protocol communications, casino game control logic, etc. (C++, C, Assembly) in the casino gaming field.
* Seven years of experience at Apple Computer, doing API-level systems testing, writing programs to test internals of system software for prototype computers before they went into production, Software Configuration Management.  Strong OOP experience on both Mac and Windows PCs.
* Analog/digital circuit experience, embedded programming, and robotic control.
* Strong video stream background, including DVR, MPEG, AVI, digital pattern recognition, 3D modeling.

Interested in all things scientific, cutting-edge, new technologies... Proud owner of an Ultimaker 3D Printer; design & prototyping.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Video recognition and automatic location of objects within view.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Socket communications, Visual Studio C++ GUI for client/server apps, MySQL database.  Remote data backup and restore.

positions.title: C++ Programmer
positions.description: Programming device drivers for various radio frequency tag scanners; useful in inventory tracking, security applications, etc.  Socket serial communications, multithreading, Window & Linux.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Sr. Software Engineer doing Video Mains Development on the V7000 and EVO video platforms.  Worked on Ticket Printing drivers interfacing with two different printer manufacturers.  Some work on the GUI system configuration interface also.  Debugging various preexisting features in the code.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Sr. Software Engineer programming and training others to program and support two slot machine platforms. Programming of serial protocol communications with various casino data gathering and progressive systems (Sigma/Mikohn Cool Millions progressive, and see Objectives above).  Communications with various secondary game devices integrated with slot machines.  Configuration and maintenance of PVCS source code archiving databases for teams of engineers. Project leader and programmer for various projects including embedded systems, communications protocols, bill acceptors, reel stepper motor drivers, and misc. gaming devices. Interfacing with regulatory agencies to debug and test new games while ensuring compliance according to regulations. On of the more interesting games I programmed is Sigmas Rock Around the Clock game.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description: Firmware engineer, working on the Poller, an integral part of the CDS Oasis player/game-tracking, and game accounting system.  Tasks include debugging/creation of new revisions, and generation of Installation disks and technical documents pertaining to configuration of Oasis software and related diagnostic procedures.

positions.title: Senior Programmer
positions.description: Senior systems level programmer for new gaming systems. Designed, documented and programmed low-level multi-tasking routines in a Unix-related OS (QNX) using C; one of these was a driver for a WBA bill acceptor. Standard team collaboration on subroutines to ensure a compatible interface between each of our routines and application program interfaces (APIs).

positions.title: Programmer & Team Lead
positions.description: Team leader in charge of those responsible for the programming of the many slot games that Sigma produces. Duties included delegating of technical tasks to team members, ensuring testing and proper submission of game software to many different gaming jurisdictions across the US and Canada, and verification of mathematical calculations required to develop successful games. Hands-on programming of the most complex aspects of various projects in 6809 assembly language; this includes network communication between slots and other casino database systems by implementing changes to networking protocols. Coding and debugging firmware for various embedded systems interface boards and their corresponding protocol APIs were a significant part of this work.

positions.title: Programmer & Tech. Lead
positions.description: Technical lead in charge of programming, and production of multimedia software relating to medical devices. The software includes comprehensive tutorials on the uses and features of infusion devices, and allows nurses and infusion device manufacturers to take on-line tests regarding the content learned within the 12 MB package. The programs are Windows based, and run on a 4 MB IBM 386 system or better. Duties include programming of the product, coordinating with graphic artists and other programmers, support of the company's computer network, and overall responsibility for the success of the project. Also responsible for acquisition of new computer systems, and software.

positions.title: Computer Test Engineer/Programmer
positions.description:
(1990 - 9/93) 
Computer Test Engineer in Central Software. Writing test plans for new Macs and related hardware, obtaining needed staffing for Application Programmer Interface (API-level) components, ensuring the creation of necessary low-level test tools, delegating testing duties, meeting project milestones, writing of final reports. Writing of various low-level test tools, participating in code reviews, low-level testing, and bug reports. 

(1988 - 1990) 
Software Configuration Management (SCM) specialist. Involved coordination between SCM, Engineering, Software QA, and Product Management. Streamlining of build processes for various software/firmware releases, creation of official SCM Alpha, Beta, and Final releases of software/firmware. Job required strong knowledge of these development systems: MPW (including Projector and EASE source-code control systems), MPWIIGS, and MPW's scripting language. Working knowledge of HyperTalk and MacApp.

positions.title: Computer Test Engineer
positions.description: Testing of prototype hardware/software in Apple's original Software Quality Assurance department; projects included Apple IIc+, Apple IIgs, AII System Disks 3.1 through 4.0. Writing of test plans, bug reports, and programs to facilitate testing. Both low-level and user-level testing
